controls: Seed manifest must bind slot task attempt continuation and current run before download.
Seed rows require an explicit schema with allowed fields and reject semantic shadow fields.
Longitude and latitude must be finite in valid ranges with explicit XY axis order.
Seed area must be finite positive and reconciled against matched geometry area with a receipted tolerance.
Catalogue response must end on the canonical HTTPS host and exact dataset path with approved query.
Bootstrap status and Location must match an explicit redirect or session-establishment allowlist.
Every archive redirect hop must preserve GET, remain HTTPS and be recorded with a bounded count.
ZIP magic, media type, Content-Disposition filename and catalogue filename must agree.
Archive member and directory counts must be bounded before extraction.
Members colliding after normalized path with conflicting CRC size or timestamps must block.
Matcher must accept only the expected INSPIRE cadastral feature type and layer role.
Feature ID and identifier properties must not disagree or map one feature to multiple target IDs.
covers versus contains boundary semantics must be explicit and receipted for each target point.
Geometry repair must record pre/post hashes and block excessive area or topology change.
EA sampler must require exactly the three unique target rows rather than only list length.
Each polygon input must bind task attempt continuation parcel HMLR ID and geometry hash.
Polygon coordinates must be finite valid 2D geometry with explicit orientation policy.
Production WCS URL must equal the official HTTPS host and service path; arbitrary override is blocked.
Capabilities DescribeCoverage and GetCoverage require bounded connect read and total deadlines.
WCS parameters must use canonical names and exact multiplicity, especially two subset parameters.
Capabilities must identify WCS 2.0.1 and the expected official service/provider metadata.
Coverage IDs colliding after Unicode or whitespace normalization must block selection.
DescribeCoverage grid CRS must bind EPSG:27700 and vertical datum semantics to ODN metres.
Range field must be elevation with metre units and one intended numeric band.
Production sampling padding must remain exactly the canonical two metres and be receipted.
GetCoverage redirects must be absent or remain on an explicit official HTTPS allowlist.
GeoTIFF must have the expected elevation band dtype scale offset and metre unit.
Transform determinant and pixel area must agree with nominal one-metre grid geometry.
Padding pixels outside the exact HMLR polygon must never enter primary statistics.
Sample output must preserve exact canonical target order with no missing or duplicate rows.
Each row must inherit capabilities DescribeCoverage request and GeoTIFF SHA lineage from one run.
Raw min max and range must be retained for acceptance before rounded presentation fields.
OS products response must be bounded JSON with an accepted schema and media type.
Selected Terrain50 product ID name version and release must form one unique exact match.
Download format must equal the official ASCII Grid and GML enum, not substring heuristics.
Download URL scheme host path and query keys must match an explicit official allowlist.
Redirect hops must not leak credentials and final host must remain an approved OS delivery host.
Archive and member names require deterministic encoding Unicode normalization and collision checks.
Recursive uncompressed bytes and member counts must be bounded across all nested archives.
The same normalized member or tile path appearing at multiple nesting levels must block.
ASC files require accepted text encoding line endings header grammar and numeric token grammar.
Every non-nodata cell must be finite and inside a documented elevation plausibility envelope.
ASCII row ordering must map north-to-south consistently with header origin and raster transform.
GML grid envelope sequence and 0-199 limits must bind the paired ASC cell layout.
PRJ must resolve to EPSG:27700 and metadata/GML vertical reference to ODN EPSG:5701.
Crosscheck must bind HMLR and EA input SHAs and deduplicate sampled cells by tile,row,column.
Loopback acceptance must request identity encoding and reconcile Content-Length with received bytes.
Index manifest operation source example and candidate assets must not redirect.
Each operation document must declare first last count and SHA-compatible identity.
Every source URL must be HTTPS without embedded credentials or fragments.
Publisher labels must agree with an authoritative domain allowlist and source role.
Example IDs must be unique stable and distinguish primary EA measurement from secondary OS crosscheck.
Failure receipts must bound error text and redact tokens cookies query keys and local secrets.
Index references must bind the exact manifest and latest assets through a published hash receipt.
Entrypoint repo root must equal canonical git toplevel branch and remote identity.
Runner output and web roots must reject symlink or reparse escapes outside the canonical worktree.
Existing named outputs must be quarantined and a run manifest written before stage execution.
Numeric promotion must bind parcel IDs and EA Terrain50 source SHAs across every stage.
Claim lease heartbeat and stage timestamps must be monotonic and trigger the 15-minute watchdog.
One manual-action record must update idempotently and resolve only after four receipts and six checks pass.
